role: Runs the late stand by the harbour where off-duty Directorate staff end up
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-21. Cast inline in `episode-c1e2--the-night-off` with no npcRef. Given a file because the stand is a place the party can return to and because she is the campaign's only civilian fixture the Directorate does not own.

Do not make her an informant. The one thing that would ruin her is turning the stand into a place where the party farms overheard conversation.

facts.text: She hears everything said at that stand and repeats none of it, deliberately and as a matter of business. Asked directly for something she overheard, she gives the same flat non-answer she gives everybody, and thinks no worse of them for asking.

revealTrigger.narrative: Trying to get something out of her about another customer.

status: DRAFT -- created 2026-09-21 to fill a cast gap in an authored scene.
